description:
Material announcements (重大訊息) of Taiwan-listed companies, translated into English: title, summary,
    category and the Chinese subject. Search by words (English or Chinese, 3+ characters), company, category
    (e.g. 'Dividends', 'Contracts and orders', 'Investments and acquisitions') and how many days
    back (the archive starts 2026-11-01). Newest first.
name: search_filings
title: Search announcements
